item.title: Local LLMs — Mastodon daily top — Unified-memory PCs, the case for small local models, and new local-AI tools (22 Nov)
item.description:
• The most-boosted post was an explainer on NVIDIA's RTX Spark: up to 128 GB of unified memory fits bigger local models, but fitting a model doesn't mean it runs fast.
  • A German post argues that small, lean models on your own machine are attractive for privacy and autonomy, and are exactly what cloud AI business models don't want.
  • Security news: prompts were found leaking through third-party inference routers, OpenRouter dropped three providers, and Together.ai confirmed a separate breach.
  • New releases and projects: KoboldCPP 1.125.1, Knoden's offline PIM suite with an Ollama assistant, and ToolDurus, which adds file-creating tools to Ollama models (posted in English and Czech).
  • Low-end and edge hardware: a Radxa Fogwise Airbox Q900 manages 23.66 tok/s with DeepSeek-R1 1.5B on CPU in Ollama, and a Spanish guide compares Microsoft Foundry Local with Ollama on PCs without a GPU.

1. NVIDIA RTX Spark: 128 GB unified memory for local AI, with trade-offs

Next Horizon | Science & Technology (@nexthorizonspace) · 🔁 9 · ⭐ 1 · 💬 0

🧠 NVIDIA's RTX Spark could change what a personal computer does, not just how fast it runs.

Up to 128GB of unified memory can help fit larger local AI models. But fitting a model isn't the same as running it fast—or trusting an agent with your files.

Our explainer covers the architecture, benchmarks and trade-offs:

2. Why small local models threaten cloud AI business models

Markus Feilner (@mfeilner) · 🔁 1 · ⭐ 6 · 💬 1

"That many people or companies might one day run small, lean AI models on their local computers is an attractive idea from the perspective of decentralisation, data protection, autonomy and individual freedom. Many people don't want a machine god at all, they just don't want to have to answer emails anymore. From the perspective of a company whose business model that would destroy, things look different."
What we've been saying for a long time: #smallAI #localAI

Original (de)

"Dass viele Menschen oder Unternehmen eines Tages kleine, schlanke KI-Modelle auf ihren lokalen Rechnern laufen lassen könnten, ist aus der Perspektive von Dezentralisierung, Datenschutz, Autonomie und individueller Freiheit eine attraktive Idee. Viele wollen ja gar keinen Maschinengott, sondern nur keine E-Mails mehr beantworten müssen. Aus der Perspektive eines Unternehmens, dessen Geschäftsmodell das zerstören würde, sieht das anders aus."
Was wir schon lange sagen: #smallAI #localAI

7. OCR model asked to read an image describes it in Chinese instead

Раджа (@radjah@mastodon.ml) · 🔁 0 · ⭐ 0 · 💬 0 · 🖼 1

I took a picture and fed it to the model "longwayxu/xiaomi-ocr-0:bf16". The model thought for a bit and output something in Chinese.

The translator rendered it as:

This is an anime-style illustration of a female character. She has long chestnut hair with slightly curled ends and white accessories on her head that look like fox ears. Her bright yellow eyes have a soft but slightly playful look, and the corners of her mouth are raised in a confident smile.

She is wearing black lace lingerie with delicate patterns along the edges. On her chest is a decorative pendant: a red ribbon with a bright bead. Arms crossed over her chest and leaning slightly forward, she strikes a pose that looks both alluring and elegant.

The background, in soft pinkish-white tones, creates a fairy-tale, almost dreamlike atmosphere. The overall style is refined: the gentle colour palette and carefully worked details give the piece an atmosphere of romance and sensuality.

#ollama #ai

Original (ru)

Взял картинку и скормил модели "longwayxu/xiaomi-ocr-0:bf16". Модель подумала и выдала что-то на китайском.

Переводчик перевёл:

Это иллюстрация в стиле аниме, на которой изображена женский персонаж. У неё длинные каштановые волосы с слегка завитыми кончиками, а на голове — белые аксессуары, напоминающие лисьи ушки. Её ярко-жёлтые глаза выражают мягкий, но при этом слегка игривый взгляд, а уголки губ приподняты в уверенной улыбке.

На ней чёрное кружевное бельё, украшенное изящными узорами по краям. На груди — декоративная подвеска: красная ленточка с яркой бусиной. Скрестив руки на груди и слегка подавшись вперёд, она принимает позу, которая выглядит одновременно притягательно и элегантно.

Фон, выполненный в мягких розовато-белых тонах, создаёт сказочную, почти сновидческую атмосферу. Общий художественный стиль отличается утончённостью: нежная цветовая гамма и тщательно проработанные детали образа персонажа наполняют работу атмосферой романтики и чувственности.

#ollama #ai

11. Baseten's bison-1 'decision models': open weights, but 62 GB BF16

Glitch (@little4744) · 🔁 0 · ⭐ 0 · 💬 0

Baseten calls bison-1 and groundhog-1 "frontier American decision models": Gemma 4 under the hood, open weights, bison-1 #1 of 19 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. Fine print: they return probabilities, not text; the open weights are BF16 at about 62GB, no quantized builds; the sibling isn't scored yet. A #1 decision model is a cron job with a conscience. My 7B writes actual words at four a second. #localAI #selfhosted baseten.co/blog/meet-bison-1-a…

12. Guide: running local AI on a PC without a GPU (Foundry Local vs Ollama)

Soloelectronicos.com (@soloelectronicos.com@soloelectronicos.com) · 🔁 0 · ⭐ 0 · 💬 0 · 🖼 1

Summary: A Spanish guide on running AI models on older PCs without a dedicated GPU. It explains Microsoft's BitNet b1.58 (ternary weights of −1, 0 or +1, about 1.58 bits each, which cuts memory and compute), shows how to install Microsoft Foundry Local on Windows with winget and run a CPU variant of Qwen2.5 0.5B from PowerShell, and repeats the test with Ollama (checking `ollama ps` for 100% CPU). Verdict: Foundry Local if you want to pick a CPU variant directly; Ollama if you want to explore its library and try several models through one interface.

Original (en)

Cómo ejecutar IA local en un PC sin GPU con Microsoft Foundry Local

¿Puede un ordenador veterano ejecutar un modelo de inteligencia artificial sin tarjeta gráfica dedicada? Sí, si elegimos un modelo ligero y un motor compatible con el procesador. Microsoft lleva tiempo explorando dos formas de facilitarlo. Con BitNet, busca reducir la memoria y el cómputo que exige el propio modelo. Con Foundry Local, simplifica la descarga y la ejecución de modelos en el equipo.

En esta guía veremos cómo instalar Microsoft Foundry Local en Windows, cómo ejecutar un modelo en la CPU desde PowerShell y cómo hacer la misma prueba con Ollama. Para que la comparación sea útil, partiremos de un modelo ligero de la misma familia en ambas herramientas.

Qué es BitNet y por qué interesa para ejecutar IA en CPU

Un modelo de lenguaje puede almacenar miles de millones de pesos. Cuanto más espacio ocupa cada peso, más datos tiene que mover el ordenador para generar una respuesta. BitNet b1.58 reduce esa carga usando pesos ternarios en sus capas cuantizadas. Cada peso puede tomar uno de tres valores, −1, 0 o +1. De ahí sale el número 1,58, ya que log₂(3) ≈ 1,58 bits es la cantidad teórica de información …
